authored: by hand from Ind AS 7 and from what TCS, RITES and RIL actually print. The Q3VENI taxonomy has NO cash-flow sheet.
tags_are_new: EVERY tag in this module is new. The customer taxonomy defines none of them, so none of these codes came from the sheet and all of them need sign-off before they are treated as canonical. They use a CF prefix so their provenance is obvious at a glance and they can never be mistaken for a Q3VENI code.

design_rules.see: field-extraction-schema.v4_3-pl.json carries the full rule text; the same seven rules apply here.
design_rules.the_statement_is_a_waterfall_not_a_tree: A cash-flow statement is a running total: profit before tax, adjusted, then working capital, then tax, giving operating cash. Most parents here are WATERFALLS over peers. Only the adjustment and working-capital blocks are true compositions.
design_rules.sign_is_carried_by_the_line_not_the_read: Filings print outflows in parentheses, and fdi.core.numbers already reads those as negative. So the adjustment and working-capital blocks are summed with weight +1 and the printed sign does the work. The only explicit -1 weights are where a filing prints a positive number that must be subtracted (taxes paid).
design_rules.three_issuers_disagree_on_labels: TCS writes 'Net cash generated from operating activities', RITES 'Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities', RIL 'Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities'. Every total therefore carries several note_aliases; the anchors in fdi.core.statements.STATEMENT_ANCHORS were widened for the same reason.

net profit before share of profit
fields.definition: The opening line of the indirect method. It is the SAME number as the P&L's PBTR; a mismatch between the two statements is a finding.

fields.field_name: Adjustments for non-cash and non-operating items
fields.definition: Items in profit that moved no cash, plus items whose cash belongs to investing or financing. Printed signs carry the direction.
Removed from operating profit here because the cash appears under investing.

adjustments for increase / decrease in operating assets
fields.definition: An increase in an operating ASSET consumes cash; an increase in an operating LIABILITY releases it. Filings already print that direction, so these are summed as printed.
Cash actually paid, which is NOT the P&L tax charge -- the gap is current-tax provisioning and refunds.

note_aliases: net cash generated from operating activities
net cash flow from operating activities
fields.definition: Taxes paid are subtracted explicitly: filings usually print this line positive under a 'less' caption rather than in parentheses.

fields.definition: The statement's own closing figure. It must equal CNBK on the balance sheet -- a cross-statement tie, and the strongest single check that both statements were read from the same basis.

fields.definition: Reported wins. The derived roll-forward is a CHECK on it; a gap means a line of the statement was missed, which is exactly what this module exists to detect.
